meta.name: improve-codebase-architecture
meta.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码库发现架构优化机会,生成可视化报告并深入剖析
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责维护日渐庞杂的代码库,想找到架构改进的发力点
copy.tagline_en: Scan your codebase for architecture improvements, then dive into each one
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to systematically uncover architecture improvement areas in your codebase

howto.what: 装上后它会扫描你的代码库,找出把「浅模块」变成「深模块」的重构机会,写一份带前后对比图的 HTML 报告到系统临时目录并打开。你选定一个候选后,它陪你逐条推敲决策,并顺带更新 CONTEXT.md 或 ADR。
howto.when: 需要手动调用,不会自动触发。当你想找代码库里值得重构的地方、或觉得某个模块难读难测时用它;若你已指明模块或痛点,它就从那里开始。

say.text: 扫描一下这个代码库,看看哪些架构可以深化
say.note: 生成 HTML 报告并打开

say.text: 先看最近改动最多的那几块代码
say.note: 按提交热区缩小扫描范围

say.text: 我想深入聊聊报告里的第二个方案

howto.what_en: It scans your codebase for refactors that turn shallow modules into deep ones, writes an HTML report with before/after diagrams to the temp folder and opens it. Once you pick a candidate, it walks its decision tree with you.
howto.when_en: Manual only — it never auto-triggers. Use it when you want to find architecture worth refactoring, or a module that is hard to read or test; name a module or pain point and it starts there.

say_en.text: Scan this codebase and show me architecture worth deepening
say_en.note: Writes an HTML report and opens it

say_en.text: Focus on the files that changed most recently
say_en.note: Narrows the scan to hot spots

say_en.text: Let's dig into the second candidate from the report
